files.text: Nice to see you, too, Steven.
Look at that man! He's very fat.
Look at that woman! She's very thin.
Look at that policeman! He's very tall.
Look at that policewoman! She's very short.
Look at that mechanic! He's very dirty.
Look at that nurse! She's very clean.
Look at Steven! He's very hot.
Look at Emma! She's very cold.
Look at that milkman! He's very old.
Look at that air hostess! She's very young.
Look at that hairdresser! He's very busy.
Look at that housewife! She's very lazy.
Look at Helen. She's very well.
Robert isn't a teacher. He's an engineer.
Mr. Blake isn't a student. He's a teacher.
This isn't my umbrella. It's your umbrella.
Sophie isn't a teacher. She's a keyboard operator.
This isn't a German car. It's a Swedish car.
